1970.notes: Columbus City Code § 361.19 (Imposition of tax; chapter 361, for taxable years prior to 2016; Municode) keeps the chapter in effect for returns and collection 'at the rate of one (1) percent with regard to all income earned prior to January 1, 1971; at the rate of one and one-half (1.5) percent with regard to all income earned ... on or after January 1, 1971 and prior to January 1, 1983'. So 1% applied throughout 1970. The ACIR Significant Features of Fiscal Federalism 1971 edition (M-57, Table 43, rates as of December 31, 1970) prints 1.5%, apparently the rate already enacted for 1971; the city's FY2001 financial report also dates the 1.5% rate to 1971.

1971.notes: 1.5% resident rate as of December 31, 1971, from the ACIR Significant Features of Fiscal Federalism 1972 edition, Table 99 (p. 227), 'Local income taxes: rates' table. The Ohio Department of Taxation's LG-11 tables (used from 2000) start in 2000; the rate in effect at December 31 is not separately confirmed.

1972.notes: The City of Columbus FY2001 Comprehensive Annual Financial Report (p. 24) states: 'The initial tax rate of .5%, collected in 1948, was increased to 1% in 1956, 1.5% in 1971, and to the current 2% in 1983.' So 1.5% applied from 1971 until the 1983 increase; the ACIR Significant Features of Fiscal Federalism editions print 1.5% at December 31, 1971, July 1, 1973, July 1, 1976 and October 1, 1979. No document for 1972 itself.
